title: docs(types,components,app-shell): declare the page-kind to node-type channel
body:
Fixes #9642

**Clause-②: no** — re-derived, not inherited. This branch adds prose and one test. No
`ComponentRegistry.register` call is added, removed or renamed; no Zod arm gains or loses a key;
no accept set moves; nothing joins a published barrel (the new symbols are a test file's locals,
and `packages/types`' `SchemaRegistry` map is untouched — adding a page-kind key there would widen
`keyof SchemaRegistry` = the published `ComponentType` union, which the map's own docblock calls a
ruling, so it is declared in a comment instead). The upstream enum lives in the sibling repository
and was read there on `origin/main`, never edited. ⇒ recording a coupling that already exists
neither relaxes an accept set nor enlarges a public surface.

---

## What the coupling actually is — and one place the card's own framing is wrong

Measured on objectui `92fba11eb` and objectstack `a7e9a66`, 2026-09-17T16:30Z UTC (clock read, not typed).

`@objectstack/spec`'s `PageTypeSchema.options` reads `record, home, app, utility, list` — five kinds,
and `page` is refused by it. The `PageRenderer` registrations read `page, app, utility, home, record`.

⇒ **They are not "the five page kinds."** Four kinds are registered; `list` is not; and `page` —
which is not a kind at all — is the fallback the same two-line mapping writes for a stored document
carrying no `type`. `list` is absent because it is ADR-0047 interface mode: `PageView` branches on
`interfaceConfig?.source` and renders `InterfaceListPage` directly, so those documents never reach
`SchemaRenderer`. Every stored `list` page in the showcase carries that key (5/5 files).

The registry resolution was read directly rather than inferred (probe run, then deleted):

| key | resolves to |
| :-- | :-- |
| `page` `app` `home` `record` `utility` | `PageRenderer` |
| `list` | a different renderer (defined, ⛔ not undefined) |
| `zzz` (absent-token control) | `undefined` |

Two controls on one instrument: `list` reading *defined-but-not-PageRenderer* separates "served
elsewhere" from "unregistered", and the absent token proves a zero out of this probe is absence
rather than a dead query.

## Where the declaration went, and why an auditor from each direction meets it

Two seats reasoned from a comment that was already there — the one at the WRITING end, in
`PageView.tsx` — and both got it wrong, because neither was reading that end. So the declaration is
placed at the READING ends, one per direction, plus one thing that cannot silently stay true.

| file | what it carries |
| :-- | :-- |
| `packages/types/src/registry.ts` | **Node-type-vocabulary auditor.** This map's own docblock makes its key set "the Single Source of Truth for component type lookups", so "is `app` a declared node type?" is answered here, with `no`. The note sits at the `page` entry and says why the gap is not the "registered but never declared" defect, and why adding keys is ⛔ not the remedy. This is the exact question both mis-framed cards asked. |
| `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts` | **Page-kind-vocabulary auditor.** `SpecPageFields`' `type` omission bullet already said spec's `type` is the kind and objectui's is the discriminator — and stopped there, reading as though the collision were resolved. It is not: the node that reaches the registry carries `type: 'app'`, which `PageNodeSchema`'s `z.literal('page')` would refuse. The bullet now states that. |
| `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx` | **Registry-file auditor.** The block sits directly above the registrations an auditor is looking at when the wrong conclusion forms. |
| `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx` | **Writing end.** Twelve lines pointing at the two reading ends and the pin, so the next editor of that mapping knows what goes red and why. |
| `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-kind-node-type-channel-9642.test.tsx` | **The mechanical half.** New; 5 cases. A comment cannot fail — this can, and its failure text names the channel instead of looking like a component bug. |
| `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-single-h1.test.tsx` | **Fixture-editing auditor.** Header note only. ⚠️ Verified on today's tree: this fixture still reads `type: 'app'` — the edit to `'page'` was never merged, so its signal is intact. The note says the value is evidence about a real stored document and points at the pin. |
| `.changeset/page-kind-node-type-channel-9642.md` | Empty frontmatter — the explicit "not shipping" declaration. |

⚠️ Measured, and worth knowing before assuming the comments ship: `//` line comments do **not**
survive into the published `.d.ts` (0 `//` hits in `dist/registry.d.ts` against **3** surviving
JSDoc blocks in the same file as the lit control), and the `SpecPageFields` docblock never projected
either — its own pre-existing phrase "genuinely collide" reads 0 in `dist/zod/layout.zod.d.ts`
against **29** surviving JSDoc blocks there. ⇒ these declarations reach a contributor reading source,
⛔ not a consumer reading the published types, and published bytes do not move.

## The scope note's sentence, and where it landed

The director's scope note adds one sentence: `AppComponentSchema`'s `app` and the spec page kind
`app` are **two vocabularies sharing one token**. It landed in **three** places, primary first:

1. `packages/types/src/registry.ts` — primary, because that is where the token's absence from the
   declared key set is read, and `AppComponentSchema` lives in the same package.
2. `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx` — beside the `app` registration itself.
3. The pin's `registryAppKeyServesThePageKind` case — the mechanical half of the sentence, asserting
   that the registry key `app` answers with `PageRenderer` (the page kind) and carrying the sentence
   in its failure message.

## Reverse verification of the pin

Committed first, then ablated, per the repo's rule. Mutation: the `app` registration replaced with a
marker line in `page.tsx`.

- on-disk proof, ⛔ not the editor's exit code — `app` registration count `1 -> 0`, injected marker count `0 -> 1`, blob `48fb716 -> 78f2858`
- run: **exit 1**, `Tests 3 failed | 2 passed (5)`, failing with the channel's own words: *"page kind 'app' ... ComponentRegistry must answer it with PageRenderer. It does not. Either the registration was removed — every stored 'app' page then renders OBJUI-001 instead of the page ..."*
- restore leg, verified by state and ⛔ not by exit code: `trap '... checkout HEAD -- PATH' EXIT INT TERM`; afterwards blob back to `48fb716`, marker count 0, `git diff HEAD` empty
- no build step is involved: the pin imports `../renderers` and `../renderers/layout/page` as relative **source**, so no `dist` sits between the mutation and the reading

⛔ Not exercised, stated rather than implied: the "upstream enum grows a kind nothing serves" leg
would need the installed `@objectstack/spec` mutated, which was not done.

## Gates — every exit code

| `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console... --concurrency=2` (locked) | **0** — 35/35 tasks |
| `pnpm exec eslint` over the 6 touched files (the repo's own `lint` form) | **0** — 0 errors, 17 warnings, all pre-existing `no-explicit-any` |

Narrowing declared: the test leg was scoped to the three packages this diff touches rather than
`pnpm test` repo-wide, and the gate list was derived from this repository's own `package.json` and
`.github/workflows/` — `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` lives in the sibling repository and refuses
objectui paths by design, so there is no `--commands` output to quote here. It is stated, ⛔ not
substituted. `pnpm install` WAS run in the worktree, so no reading was lost to a missing install.
A repo-wide `eslint .` was not run: the repo's `lint` is per-package via turbo, and the six touched
files were linted directly.

⚠️ `--no-inline-config` is **not** this repository's lint form and reported one spurious error
(`react-hooks/static-components` at a pre-existing line that carries its own `eslint-disable-next-line`);
re-run in the repo's own form it is 0. Recorded because the wrong form reads as a real finding.

## `check:changeset-claims` — ten verdicts, read by paragraph

The gate is report-only and exits 0. **10** pending entries name a file this diff touches. Verdict
per entry, each with the reading behind it. ⛔ Nothing was corrected: this diff falsifies none of them.

### The decisive instrument, covering the eight "claims about code"

Every one of the five modified files is **byte-identical to its base after comment stripping** —
stripped through the TypeScript scanner (`SingleLineCommentTrivia` / `MultiLineCommentTrivia`
dropped), sha256 compared:

| file | stripped sha (base == head) | stripped bytes |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx` | `3e8a4778f747` | 5009 |
| `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-single-h1.test.tsx` | `77005bcb825e` | 4649 |
| `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx` | `a5af90104700` | 20919 |
| `packages/types/src/registry.ts` | `7c86c6a7aa64` | 3691 |
| `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts` | `45dff251cb6a` | 25925 |

Positive control: the stripper genuinely removes comments (`page.tsx` 32152 raw -> 20919 stripped).
Negative control: the same instrument reports DIFFERS when handed two genuinely different files.
⇒ ⛔ No claim about a `.default()` population, an accept set, a schema arm, a key, a registration,
a `.describe()` string or any symbol count can be moved by this diff.

### ⚠️ The two entries whose claims are counts over FILE CONTENT — a docblock IS file content

These are the ones the strip proof does **not** cover, so each was probed directly.

- **`.changeset/8871-page-node-refuses-breadcrumbs.md`** — claims `\.breadcrumbs` is *"exit 0 over
  **4 files** — every hit one of this branch's own four files (this changeset, the refusal pin,
  `layout.ts`, `zod/layout.zod.ts`)"*. Probed tree-wide at base `92fba11eb` and at head
  `5b293107f`: **4 files at both**, and they are exactly the four named. Lit control on the same
  instrument, `\.breadcrumb\b`: **16 files at both** — which is also the number that paragraph
  states for head. Absent-token control exits 1. And `git diff base..head | grep -ci breadcrumb`
  is **0** — this diff adds no mention of the token in any spelling. **STILL TRUE; ⛔ nothing corrected.**
- **`.changeset/8478-describe-line-addresses.md`** — claims certain line addresses in
  `layout.zod.ts` are out of scope. `layout.zod.ts` carries exactly **1** line-address citation at
  base and **1** at head: `` `page.tsx:521` ``. My insertion into `page.tsx` begins at line **708**,
  so 521 is not shifted — verified by content, not arithmetic: lines 519-523 of `page.tsx` are
  byte-identical at base and head. ⭐ And that address sits in a **JSDoc block, not a
  `.describe()` string**, so the entry's claim (which is about published `.describe()` descriptions)
  does not reach it at all. Two independent reasons. **STILL TRUE of this diff; ⛔ nothing corrected.**

### The other eight

Each is covered by the strip proof; two also carry a probe over a file this diff touches, and both
probes were re-run rather than reasoned about.

- **`7926-page-node-refuses-actions.md`** — *"`git grep -ni action` on `page.tsx` returns only the
  `PageVariableActionBridge` import and its render"*. Re-run at base and at head: **byte-identical
  hit sets, 4 lines each, same line numbers**. Its second claim (3 `actions` author sites, all in
  `content/docs/guide/layout.md`) is over a file this diff does not touch. **STILL TRUE.**
- **`page-source-tailwind-prose-retraction-5469.md`** — claims a specific `kind === 'html'`
  dispatch-arm comment in `page.tsx` does **not** project into `dist`. Mine is a different comment
  and likewise does not project (0 hits in `dist/renderers/layout/page.d.ts` after a real build).
  **STILL TRUE.**
- **`6951-text-value-retired.md`** (`TextSchema.value` tombstone; *"the `value?: string` members of
  `TextSpanSchema` and `TabsSchema` in the same file are other schemas' contracts and are
  unchanged"*) · **`7735-zod-mirrors-stop-authoring-defaults.md`** (41 `.default()` call sites
  removed, `layout.zod.ts` 22) · **`8478-zod-pins-form-layout.md`** · **`8499-node-slot-registered-arms.md`**
  (four named arms) · **`8505-grid-columns-breakpoint-narrowing.md`** (`GridSchema.columns`) ·
  **`8516-8556-mirror-partial-record-narrowing.md`** (the mirror-narrowing table) — every claim is
  about a schema member, an arm, a call-site population or an accept set, and the stripped-source
  identity above says none of those can have moved. None names a comment. **ALL STILL TRUE.**

### ⛔ Already false before this branch existed — reported, ⛔ not corrected

- `8478-describe-line-addresses.md` says the remaining addresses are *"held by **in-flight** PR
  objectui#8763"*. That PR is **merged** (read from the API), so the present-tense clause is stale;
  its companion `8478-zod-pins-form-layout.md` carries the same shape — but for PR
  objectui#8799 (merged), **not** objectui#8766. ⚠️ Corrected by the PM against the file itself:
  objectui#8766 appears in `8478-describe-line-addresses.md`, already in the past tense and
  accurate there ("cleared when that PR merged during this round"), so it needs no repair.
  Both stale present-tense claims are now carded as objectui#9706. Its cardinal has moved too: the three files it names carry **2 / 1 / 7** line-address
  citations today (`form.zod.ts` / `layout.zod.ts` / `complex.zod.ts`), identical at base and head.
  ⇒ falsified by other branches' merges, ⛔ not by this diff, and ⛔ not this card's to repair.
- Recorded because it looks like a finding and is not: my 40-line insertion into
  `packages/types/src/registry.ts` shifts a **pre-existing** citation (`` `renderer.tsx:256` ``,
  the chatbot note) from host line 264 to 304. The **cited** line is in
  `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/renderer.tsx`, which this diff does not touch, so the address still
  points where it did. No changeset names `registry.ts`.

## Acceptance notes

- ⭐ **A premise on the card is wrong and is worth carrying forward.** The card and the letter-E
  ruling both describe the registrations as "the five page kinds". They are four kinds plus the
  untyped-document fallback `page`; the fifth kind, `list`, is served by the interface-mode branch
  and is registered elsewhere, to a different renderer. Nothing in the ruling turns on this — E
  stands either way — but a declaration that repeated the card's wording would have been wrong on
  its face, so the wording above is the measured shape instead.
- ⚠️ The card says *"No test in this repository renders a stored page document through the real
  `SchemaRenderer`."* Read narrowly about `PageView`'s own test that is right; read as written it is
  not. `page-single-h1.test.tsx` renders a stored-page-shaped document with `type: 'app'` through
  the real `SchemaRenderer` — which is why removing the `app` registration reddens it. What was
  missing is not coverage but **attribution**: it goes red for a reason that reads as a heading bug.
  The new pin supplies that, ⛔ and no rendering suite was built as this card's deliverable.
- `PageNodeSchema` pins `type` to `z.literal('page')` while the node `PageView` actually emits
  carries the kind. Noted, ⛔ not filed and ⛔ not repaired: it is the same undeclared channel this
  card exists to declare, and reconciling it is the render-path change the card fences off.
- The showcase census re-derived here agrees with the ruling's R2 (`home` 8, `app` 6, `list` 5,
  `record` 3, `utility` 0) on the same instrument shape — but that instrument **undercounts**: one
  file defines seven pages sharing one spread `type: 'list' as const` base, so 22 page-level `type`
  hits stand against 28 `definePage(` calls. The `utility` zero stands beside a `home` 8 firing
  control and an absent-token zero on the same instrument. Reported, ⛔ not filed: no disposition
  here depends on the cardinal.
- Not done, deliberately: no registration added/removed/renamed, `PageTypeSchema` untouched, the
  render path untouched, no name added to a published barrel, no label or ready flip, no
  auto-merge, no labels touched.

## 维护者速读

**改了什么** — 六个源文件加了注释、一个新的 pin 测试、一个空 frontmatter 的 changeset。零行为改动:没有增删改任何
`ComponentRegistry.register`,没有动任何 Zod arm,没有动上游枚举(它在兄弟仓,只读)。

**为什么改** — 存储的页面文档的 `type` 就是 spec 的页面 KIND,`PageView` 把它原样写进
`ComponentRegistry` 用来分发的节点判别符。于是 `PageRenderer` 上那几个注册项**是因为这一行才存在的**。
过去没有任何地方声明这件事,所以审计注册表的人看到「注册了但没有 schema 声明」——这在本仓是一个真实的缺陷
形态。这个误读已经产出两张方向错误的卡,其中一张走到了 draft PR,若落地会让六个已发布的 showcase 页面停止渲染
(页面位置画出 OBJUI-001)。现在这条通道在**两个审计入口**各写了一份声明,并由一个失败时会指名这条通道的测试钉住。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 风险极低:注释不参与编译语义,且实测不进入已发布的 `.d.ts`;唯一的可执行新增是一个
只读注册表、不渲染任何东西的测试。代价是这个 pin 会在有人改动这条通道时变红——这正是它存在的意义,⛔ 不要靠改
fixture 把它弄绿。回滚:`git revert` 这一个 commit 即可,没有迁移、没有数据形态变化、没有发布面变化。

**你要做的** — 判两件事。① 声明放的位置对不对:`packages/types/src/registry.ts` 的 `page` 条目(节点类型词汇表
的审计入口)与 `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts` 的 `SpecPageFields` 注释(页面 KIND 词汇表的审计入口),
是否真的是**两个方向的审计者各自会撞上**的地方。② 卡面「五个注册项就是五个页面 KIND」这个说法实测不成立(是四个
KIND + 一个无 `type` 文档的兜底 `page`,第五个 KIND `list` 走 interface 模式、由别的渲染器注册),本 PR 按实测
措辞而非按卡面措辞落笔——请确认这个取舍。
